{{Top|leg}}
'''Fusion lathes''' could be used to manufacture simple [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts from scratch. The machine shop at [[Docking Bay 99]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was equipped with a fusion lathe.
